source.timing_limit: Reconstructed recording assumes 30 fps. Offsets are file timing, not independently recovered wall-clock timing.

method: Decode genuine source frames in chronological order; crop, resize, add out-of-image labels, and GIF palette quantization. No generated screen content, optical-flow interpolation, reverse sequence, added click indicators, or fabricated navigation. The GIF wraps directly from its last recorded frame to its first; repeats are playback, not additional events.

clips.title: I told Grok to stop. Its chat becomes active again.
clips.description: Idle parent chat changes to Finished Recovery audit W1 plan / Planning next moves, with an active stop control. No new user message is visible. The trigger is not established.
